number.description: The heading's printed number or letter exactly as printed, e.g. '2', '2.1', 'IV.', 'A.'; null when the heading is unnumbered.

title.description: The heading text exactly as printed, without its number.

level.description: 1 for a top-level heading, 2 for a subsection, 3 below that.

page.description: The 1-based PDF page the heading is printed on.

role.description: front_matter: abstract, keywords and similar before the main text; main: the paper's argument; back_matter: acknowledgments, funding, author notes, declarations; references: the bibliography; appendix: appendices and supplementary material.

outline.description: The paper's own headings as printed, in reading order. Empty when the paper prints no headings.
